summary: Security lens. The provenance chain is anti-forgery by construction: markers and rounds are minted only by the hook from live tool events; recorders compare digests, never trust payload claims; the plan-mode file is hashed after write (no TOCTOU on the gate side since approve re-checks); fail-open is confined to the logging hook while every enforcement point fails closed. No secrets, no network, no new subprocess with user-controlled argv (the hook execs a fixed script via forge.py dispatch). AskUserQuestion free text (notes/annotations/descriptions) is never persisted — only question, option labels, chosen. The parity exemption is event-name-narrow. A malicious session without the hook simply cannot save plans or record grills (refusal, not escalation).
residual_risks: A local actor can still hand-craft marker JSON files on disk; unchanged trust model — the repo owner already owns the ledger (decision 0017), and PR review sees committed records
